description: Na₃Y(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.55 Å. Y is bonded to seven O atoms to form corner-sharing YO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.41 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Y, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂YB trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Y, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃YB trigonal bipyramids.
